limitations: Two observations per arm; not a p50/p99 benchmark or whole-block throughput claim.
Measured macOS M5 Max,16 prover workers. NUMA placement and performance on other hosts require independent qualification.
Whole-process counters include all threads within intervals; nested intervals must not be summed.
No cache retention added; semantic BINARY-v2 change was already present in all four arms.
